summary: Steep residential kerb with houses 3-10 m away along the whole east side.

drivers.seclusion: Detached houses front the east kerb at 3-10 m for the full length; homes on the west side too.

drivers.convention: A few cars park on the east kerb; no signs; no overnight habit visible.
